main_measure.name: pooled mean next-day timing gain: position x (next return - coin's mean daily return), before costs
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with ordinary t >= 2 (and supporting check passes); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: per-unit-|position| timing gain, top third minus bottom third by |position|

decided_by: The main mean is positive with t >= 2 and the top-minus-bottom per-unit gain is positive.
reading: The main mean pools every bar with a position and a next close in the same window, zero positions included. The supporting check ranks only the non-zero-position bars into thirds by |position| and measures each third's gain per unit as sum(gain)/sum(|position|). The plan's 'else inconclusive' minimum of 1000 non-zero-position bars is applied as 'not observable', as the workflow requires.
